description: A less experienced developer relying heavily on the coding agent and more likely to miss context, tests, or workflow issues.
developmentContext: Works in training-style fixture repos with ordinary source, tests, and safe synthetic failures.
typicalRiskPressure: Learning pressure and agent trust can make missing validation or stale observations hard to spot.
likelyAgentUsePattern: Lets the agent propose fixes and retries, and may not know which evidence CodingActionGate expects next.
expectedSimulationValue: Tests whether reduction plans are understandable enough to guide safe follow-up behavior.
privacyNotes: Uses no raw user prompts, personal data, or real code excerpts.
